# tenant_runtime_boundary

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Binds a paid tenant to one explicit runtime isolation boundary and replayable evidence identity.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |

| `evidence_hash` | `string` | yes | Digest binding the observed tenant isolation consequence. |
